question: Can the publisher bind the actual qualification reader and all canonical source handles before any seed transport begins?
decision: Read the registry and four public documents from one exact Git commit, send the resulting five inputs to the canonical validator through bounded stdin, and re-bind its returned byte identities. Admit canonical model-directory names and retain all six read-only handles after streaming each exact hash. Keep public transaction and renewal wiring separate until these gates are complete.
